title: Pointer to the properties of the derived categories
text:
In the notation of [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], the following holds.
That the stalk functors [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks] are exact and pass to
the derived categories is [prop-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks-exact], and that
they are jointly conservative on $D^+(T_{\Et})$ is
[lem-weil-pbc-derived-stalk-conservative].
